features.body: Checks COPYRIGHT, then LICENSE, in the working directory. Set filename & cwd to look anywhere else: the first match wins.
features.title: Finds your license file

features.body: The header is a /*! comment, the form most CSS minifiers keep, so the license reaches your published files.
features.title: Survives minification

features.body: A missing or empty license file adds a PostCSS warning that names where it looked. Your build keeps going.
features.title: Warns instead of failing

features.body: Empty files stay empty instead of becoming a lone license comment. Turn skipIfEmpty off if you want the header anyway.
features.title: Skips empty stylesheets

lede: A PostCSS plugin that prepends your COPYRIGHT or LICENSE file to each stylesheet as a /*! … */ comment. No file? You get a warning, not a failed build.

usage.caption: Looks for COPYRIGHT, then LICENSE, in the working directory.
